detail.title: Economic Growth: Market Size, Exchange Rates, Corruption Perception Index (CPI), Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Industry Bio Plastic

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study. The analysis of Economic Growth—covering market size, exchange rates, the Corruption Perception Index (CPI), Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in the bioplastic industry—was conducted independently, without any external influence from organizations or individuals.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animals. The research focuses exclusively on economic growth indicators—market size, exchange rates, the Corruption Perception Index (CPI), Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)—within the bioplastic industry. All data analyzed were obtained from publicly available statistical and institutional sources. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study. This research on Economic Growth—specifically market size, exchange rates, the Corruption Perception Index (CPI), Information and Communication Technology (ICT), and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in the bioplastic industry—was conducted independently. The authors further state that this study did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors, and no external organization had any role in the design, data collection, analysis, interpretation, or decision to publish the findings.

detail.abstract: The bioplastic-based industry has been growing rapidly due to increasing global demand for sustainable products. This study aims to analyze the determinants of bioplastic industry. This study investigates the complex relationship between market size, exchange rate, inflation, Corruption Perception Index (CPI), Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in bioplastics promotion, and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) on economic growth. Using a panel data approach, the study analysed data from Indonesia, China, and Singapore over the period 2019-2023, and revealed that larger market sizes significantly attract FDI due to greater consumer potential and investment opportunities. In addition, a stable exchange rate proved to be crucial in mitigating the risks associated with currency fluctuations, thereby increasing the attractiveness of a country for foreign investors to invest in the bioplastics industry. The findings also suggest that high levels of perceived corruption negatively impact economic growth by undermining governance and investor confidence. Although the direct effect of Technology in the promotion of industrial bioplastics on economic growth is not very large, its role in improving operational efficiency and market access is recognised. The paper concludes with policy recommendations aimed at fostering a conducive investment environment through market expansion, exchange rate stability, anti-corruption measures, and Technology development. These insights contribute to a deeper understanding of the dynamics affecting FDI in the bioplastics industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用面板数据分析方法，探讨了市场规模、汇率、通胀、腐败感知指数、信息通信技术和外国直接投资对生物塑料产业经济增长的影响。研究发现市场规模和汇率稳定对吸引FDI至关重要，腐败对经济增长有负面影响，ICT虽对经济增长直接影响不大但能提升运营效率。
AI.research_question: 生物塑料产业发展的决定因素是什么？具体而言，市场规模、汇率、通货膨胀、腐败感知指数、信息通信技术和外国直接投资如何影响生物塑料产业的经济增长？
AI.motivation: 全球对可持续产品的需求不断增长，推动了生物塑料产业的快速发展。然而，该产业发展的关键决定因素尚不明确，需要深入分析以制定有效的政策促进产业发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外国直接投资理论、制度经济学理论和技术采纳理论，研究探讨了宏观经济因素（市场规模、汇率、通胀）、制度因素（腐败感知指数）和技术因素（ICT）对生物塑料产业发展的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用面板数据分析方法，收集了印度尼西亚、中国和新加坡2019-2023年的数据，分析市场规模、汇率、通货膨胀、腐败感知指数、信息通信技术和外国直接投资对经济增长的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 市场规模显著吸引外国直接投资；2. 汇率稳定对降低投资风险至关重要；3. 腐败感知指数高会负面影响经济增长；4. 信息通信技术对经济增长直接影响有限，但能提升运营效率和市场准入。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了外国直接投资理论在可持续产业中的应用，整合了制度因素和技术因素对产业发展的影响机制，为理解生物塑料产业发展提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体建议：扩大市场规模、保持汇率稳定、加强反腐败措施、发展信息通信技术，以创造有利于生物塑料产业投资的环境。

title: Capital Efficiency, Value Added and Sustainability in the Energy Sector (Nuclear, Coal, Gas & Renewable Energy Entities)

detail.title: Capital Efficiency, Value Added and Sustainability in the Energy Sector (Nuclear, Coal, Gas & Renewable Energy Entities)
detail.abstract: The paper aims to examine the value added of intellectual capital of different types of enterprises in the energy sector in Bulgaria and to seek a connection with their sustainability through a multi-dimensional approach. For this purpose, nuclear (probably green), coal (called brown energy), gas and oil companies and producers of electricity from renewable sources have been selected. Primary data from the annual financial statements of the surveyed enterprises were used. Intellectual capital in companies is formed from various sources such as social capital and human capital. Part of the human and social capital is also formed by human and national spirituality. It will play a leading role in the new economy and the so-called Fourth Industrial Revolution. The expansion of the application of artificial intelligence, which is essentially intellectual capital from an economic point of view, is a legitimate reason for the extraction of intellectual capital as a basis for the efficiency of enterprises and their sustainability. The main method used is the original VAIC tm, combined with correlation, cluster analysis, carbon, and water footprint assessment. The sustainability of enterprises in this study is considered as economic, environmental, and social, in contrast to the dominant thesis about the priority of the environmental component of sustainability. The study seeks a link between the efficiency of intellectual capital, the overall ability of enterprises to use intellectual capital and the sustainability of enterprises. Intellectual capital is capital that is generally never fully depreciated. With the shutdown of non-environmental energy production, the efficiency of their intellectual capital will cease to be used. In this perspective, partial conclusions have been drawn about the cost of the transition to a green economy, an economy dominated by intellectual capital. The study does not claim completeness and a final solution to the issues raised. The article aims to present a more diverse and balanced approach to the assessment of losses and benefits in the planned path of transformation of the economy from the production of electricity from non-renewable to the production of energy from renewable sources.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用VAIC方法结合相关性和聚类分析，探讨保加利亚能源部门不同类型企业智力资本的价值增值及其与企业可持续发展的关系，特别关注向绿色经济转型过程中的成本效益评估。
AI.research_question: 保加利亚能源部门不同类型企业的智力资本价值增值如何？智力资本效率与企业可持续发展（经济、环境、社会三个维度）之间存在怎样的联系？
AI.motivation: 在第四次工业革命和人工智能快速发展的背景下，智力资本成为企业效率和可持续发展的关键基础。研究旨在为从非可再生能源向可再生能源转型的经济转型路径提供更全面、平衡的损失与收益评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智力资本理论（包括社会资本、人力资本）、可持续发展三重底线理论（经济、环境、社会）、VAIC（智力资本增值系数）方法、绿色经济转型理论
AI.method: 使用原始VAIC方法，结合相关性分析、聚类分析、碳足迹和水足迹评估，分析保加利亚能源企业（核能、煤炭、天然气、石油、可再生能源）的年度财务报表数据
AI.findings: 研究发现智力资本效率与企业可持续发展存在联系，但非环保能源生产关闭后，其智力资本效率将无法继续利用。研究对向绿色经济转型的成本提出了部分结论，强调智力资本主导经济的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了智力资本理论在能源部门的实证应用；挑战了可持续发展中以环境维度为主的传统观点，提出了经济、环境、社会三个维度的平衡视角；为绿色经济转型中的智力资本价值评估提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源企业管理者提供了智力资本效率评估工具；为政策制定者评估能源转型的成本效益提供了多维分析方法；帮助企业理解智力资本在可持续发展中的战略价值

title: Digitalization of Sustainability Reporting as a Way to Increase Its Analytical Value

detail.title: Digitalization of Sustainability Reporting as a Way to Increase Its Analytical Value
detail.abstract: Currently, digitalization is covering all areas of society and business. This process also extends to the creation of corporate reporting, including not only financial data but also extensive non-financial information on the organization's activities which stakeholders are increasingly demanding. In response to these trends, in the spring of 2024 the International Sustainability Standards Board released the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Taxonomy allowing the creation of nonfinancial reporting in a digital format.

AI.tldr: 国际可持续发展准则理事会发布IFRS可持续发展披露分类标准，使非财务报告能够以数字格式创建，回应利益相关者对数字化企业报告的需求。
AI.research_question: IFRS可持续发展披露分类标准如何促进企业非财务报告的数字化转型？
AI.motivation: 数字化正在覆盖社会和商业的各个领域，利益相关者对包含财务和非财务信息的数字化企业报告需求日益增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业报告数字化理论、可持续发展报告框架、XBRL分类标准理论、利益相关者理论。
AI.method: 文献分析、政策文件分析、分类标准技术分析、案例研究。
AI.findings: IFRS可持续发展披露分类标准为创建数字格式的非财务报告提供了技术框架，有助于提高报告的透明度、可比性和可访问性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业报告数字化理论，建立了可持续发展报告与数字技术的理论联系，丰富了利益相关者理论在数字化环境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了创建数字格式非财务报告的技术标准，提高了报告效率，增强了利益相关者的信息获取能力，促进了可持续发展信息的传播。

title: US Fiscal Trap Analysis: Hedging The Sovereign Risk Scenario
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: US Fiscal Trap Analysis: Hedging The Sovereign Risk Scenario
detail.abstract: This memorandum provides an analysis of an investment strategy based on a hypothetical but highly probable scenario for the development of events in the United States. The core of the scenario is the emergence of a "fiscal trap": a combination of irreversible corporate tax cuts and a shock loss of budget revenues due to the judicial cancellation of large-scale protectionist duties. The pressure on public finances is compounded by the potential need for compensation payments to businesses. The Memorandum details two key macroeconomic outcomes (high and low inflation) and offers a unique combined strategy that is neutral to the inflationary scenario. The strategy is aimed at extracting benefits from: • The inevitable change of the Fed's monetary regime through the "steeper" position on the yield curve. • A fundamental deterioration in the creditworthiness of the United States through the purchase of credit default swaps (CDS). The purpose of the document is to justify a diversified approach that hedges the risks of uncertainty and allows you to profit from structural imbalances rather than speculative guessing of short-term trends.

AI.tldr: 本文分析基于美国可能出现的"财政陷阱"情景的投资策略：不可逆转的企业减税与保护性关税司法取消导致财政收入冲击，加上潜在的企业补偿支付压力。策略通过收益率曲线陡峭化头寸和购买信用违约互换(CDS)来获利，对高通胀和低通胀两种情景保持中性。
AI.research_question: 在美国可能出现的"财政陷阱"情景下，如何构建一个对通胀情景保持中性的投资策略，从美联储货币政策转变和美国信用基本面恶化中获利？
AI.motivation: 美国面临财政陷阱风险：不可逆转的企业减税与保护性关税司法取消导致财政收入冲击，加上潜在企业补偿支付压力，可能引发结构性财政失衡。需要构建对冲不确定性风险并从结构性失衡中获利的投资策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政陷阱理论、货币政策传导机制、收益率曲线理论、信用风险定价理论、情景分析与对冲策略理论。
AI.method: 情景分析法：构建高通胀和低通胀两种宏观经济情景；投资组合构建：结合收益率曲线陡峭化头寸（从美联储货币政策转变中获利）和信用违约互换（CDS）购买（从美国信用基本面恶化中获利）。
AI.findings: 提出了一个独特的组合策略：1）通过收益率曲线陡峭化头寸从美联储货币政策必然转变中获利；2）通过购买信用违约互换从美国信用基本面恶化中获利。该策略对通胀情景保持中性，能够对冲不确定性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了"财政陷阱"情景下的投资策略理论框架；2）发展了通胀中性投资组合构建方法；3）整合了货币政策传导与信用风险管理的投资理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资者提供了在美国财政风险情景下的具体投资策略；2）展示了如何构建对冲不确定性风险的投资组合；3）提供了从结构性失衡而非短期趋势猜测中获利的实践方法。

title: Mises's Fatal Flaw: Binding Deficits and the Memetic Evolution of Political Liberalism

detail.title: Mises's Fatal Flaw: Binding Deficits and the Memetic Evolution of Political Liberalism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No financial relationships or competing interests influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzed publicly available legal documents and constitutional provisions; no human subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author conducted this work independently.

detail.abstract:
In Human Action (1949), Ludwig von Mises diagnosed a “fateful error” in classical liberalism: faith that rationality suffices for political persuasion. This paper translates Mises’s diagnosis into memetic theory, revealing a dual structural deficiency: a binding deficit (psychological incapacity to generate identity adhesion independent of instrumental outcomes) and vulnerability to entrenched power networks (material interests with high binding and concrete resources). Liberalism optimized for propositional coherence while neglecting the psychological infrastructure for durable mass replication and the resistance of networks combining tribal loyalty with tangible benefits.

I distinguish between memetic content (propositions, institutions) and transmission vehicles (identity structures, rituals). Classical liberalism conflated these dimensions. Mises recognized the error but offered no solution without abandoning rationalism itself. Contemporary Latin American liberal movements have discovered a dual workaround: (1) hybridization with high-binding sources (evangelical narratives, religious symbolism); (2) explicit attacks on embedded networks. This separation of content from vehicle, combined with delegitimizing material power structures, represents a testable evolutionary innovation.

Six historical cases (French Revolution, Comte’s positivism, Soviet Union, Kemalism, Argentine Enlightenment, contemporary Latin America) spanning two centuries and three continents reveal a universal pattern: rationalist projects, regardless of ideological content, face identical binding deficits and power network resistance. Evidence from Argentina and Brazil (2018-2025) shows liberal governments adopting religious outreach strategies coinciding with structural attacks on established political networks. Preliminary data suggest resilience to economic crises and cross-spectrum competition for religious binding, with actors from opposed ideological positions seeking evangelical constituencies.

The framework contributes to Extended Phenotype Theory by formalizing binding coefficients as institutional fitness predictors, explaining persistent dysfunction, and proposing testable predictions about hybridization dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文将米塞斯对古典自由主义"致命错误"的诊断转化为模因理论，揭示了双重结构缺陷：结合赤字（无法产生独立于工具性结果的身份认同）和对根深蒂固权力网络的脆弱性。论文提出通过内容与传播载体的分离（结合高结合力来源并攻击嵌入网络）作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么理性主义政治项目（如古典自由主义）在政治说服中失败？如何克服理性主义意识形态在传播中的结构缺陷？
AI.motivation: 古典自由主义和其他理性主义政治项目在历史上未能实现持久的大众传播，尽管其命题具有逻辑一致性。米塞斯诊断出这一"致命错误"，但未提供解决方案。需要理解理性主义意识形态的结构缺陷并找到实际应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模因理论、扩展表型理论、结合系数作为制度适应性预测指标、内容与传播载体的分离理论、理性主义政治传播的结构缺陷分析
AI.method: 历史案例研究（法国大革命、孔德实证主义、苏联、凯末尔主义、阿根廷启蒙运动、当代拉丁美洲）、当代实证分析（阿根廷和巴西2018-2025年数据）、比较分析跨越两个世纪和三个大陆的六个案例
AI.findings: 1. 理性主义项目普遍面临结合赤字和权力网络抵抗；2. 当代拉丁美洲自由主义运动通过双重策略获得成功：与高结合力来源（福音派叙事、宗教象征）杂交，并明确攻击嵌入网络；3. 分离内容与传播载体是可行的进化创新；4. 初步数据显示这种策略对经济危机具有韧性，并引发跨意识形态对宗教结合力的竞争
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化结合系数作为制度适应性预测指标；2. 解释理性主义政治项目的持续功能障碍；3. 提出关于杂交动态的可检验预测；4. 为扩展表型理论做出贡献；5. 建立内容与传播载体的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为自由主义运动提供可行的传播策略：结合宗教叙事并攻击既得利益网络；2. 展示如何在不放弃理性主义核心内容的情况下增强意识形态传播力；3. 提供应对经济危机和政治竞争的实际指导；4. 为政治运动设计提供基于模因理论的框架

title: Modeling Adaptive Success: A Discrete Hill-Type Hazard Approach in Education
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Modeling Adaptive Success: A Discrete Hill-Type Hazard Approach in Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves the secondary analysis of the de-identified Cognitive Tutor Algebra I dataset, which is publicly available via the Pittsburgh Science of Learning Center (PSLC) DataShop. As a secondary analysis of anonymized public data, further Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Traditional models of student performance and item mastery often assume a constant probability of success across attempts-for example, the geometric distribution. Such models cannot capture the "aha" moment where performance transitions from repeated failure to rapid success. In this work, we adapt a discrete Hill-type hazard (equivalently, a log-logistic hazard function) to the problem of first success over repeated attempts in educational settings. We use this trial-indexed success probability, τ (n; h, K) = n h /(n h + K h), as the discrete hazard of a nonhomogeneous geometric process governing the trial of first success. The resulting model-which we refer to as the Learner's Tau framework-is governed by a steepness parameter h and a midpoint parameter K and is designed to capture adaptive success in systems where the probability of success increases over time, such as human learning, reinforcement learning, and task mastery. We derive the probability mass function, analyze key mathematical properties, and introduce a set of interpretable summary quantities-including the discrete hazard function, a Difficulty Ratio K/h, an Early Success Probability (the CDF evaluated at the midpoint), the Mean Time to Mastery, and the Peak Effort Trial where effort-weighted success is maximized. Using numerical simulations and maximum likelihood estimation, we demonstrate that the model can recover underlying parameters and distinguish between qualitatively different learner profiles. Empirical validation using educational data from the Cognitive Tutor system demonstrates that the model captures learning dynamics significantly better than a memoryless geometric baseline for non-trivial tasks (∆AIC = 8.0 and 16.6 for two algebra skills), while appropriately deferring to the simpler model when ceiling effects preclude observable learning. Rather than proposing a brand-new functional form, this work adapts a classical Hill-type hazard to an explicitly discrete, learning-centric context and highlights its utility for modeling adaptive success trajectories in education.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Learner's Tau框架，采用离散Hill型风险函数（对数逻辑风险函数）建模学生在重复尝试中的首次成功概率，捕捉从反复失败到快速成功的"顿悟时刻"，在教育数据上优于传统几何分布模型。
AI.research_question: 如何建模学生在重复尝试中从失败到成功的"顿悟时刻"学习动态？
AI.motivation: 传统学生表现和项目掌握模型（如几何分布）假设成功概率恒定，无法捕捉从反复失败到快速成功的"顿悟时刻"学习动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散Hill型风险函数（对数逻辑风险函数），非齐次几何过程，Learner's Tau框架。
AI.method: 理论推导概率质量函数和关键数学性质，数值模拟和最大似然估计验证参数可恢复性，使用Cognitive Tutor系统教育数据进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 模型能捕捉学习动态，在非平凡任务上显著优于无记忆几何基线模型（两个代数技能的∆AIC分别为8.0和16.6），在存在天花板效应时适当退回到简单模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经典Hill型风险函数适应到离散、学习中心化的情境，提出Learner's Tau框架，推导出可解释的总结量（难度比、早期成功概率、平均掌握时间、峰值努力试验）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者提供工具区分不同学习者类型，识别"顿悟时刻"，优化教学干预时机，在智能辅导系统中实现个性化学习路径。

title: The Solvency Protocol: A Forensic Reconstruction of the 2008 Financial Crisis via Ternary Logic Architectures

detail.title: The Solvency Protocol: A Forensic Reconstruction of the 2008 Financial Crisis via Ternary Logic Architectures
detail.abstract: The Global Financial Crisis (GFC) of 2008 was characterized by a systemic failure to verify asset quality, resulting in the accumulation of toxic debt within opaque financial instruments. This report argues that the crisis was facilitated by a fundamental deficiency in binary financial architectures, which lack a computational state to represent "uncertainty." Consequently, ambiguous assets (such as opaque CDOs) were processed as valid (+1) rather than quarantined. We present a counterfactual forensic analysis using Ternary Logic (TL), a computational framework that introduces a mandatory "Sacred Zero" (State 0) or "Epistemic Hold." By applying TL to historical failure nodes-specifically Lehman Brothers' Repo 105, Clayton Holdings' waived loans, and the AIG collateral disputes-we demonstrate how a ternary architecture would have structurally prevented the crisis by enforcing a "Solvency Protocol." This protocol mandates that unverified assets remain in a state of suspended execution until cryptographically validated, effectively neutralizing the contagion vectors of shadow banking.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出2008年全球金融危机源于二元金融架构缺乏表示"不确定性"的计算状态，导致不透明资产被错误处理。通过引入三元逻辑框架和"神圣零"状态，建立"偿付能力协议"，可结构性防止危机。
AI.research_question: 如何通过计算架构创新（三元逻辑）来结构性防止类似2008年全球金融危机的系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 2008年金融危机暴露了传统二元金融架构的根本缺陷：无法处理资产质量的不确定性，导致有毒债务在金融体系中积累和传播。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元逻辑理论、计算状态理论、金融架构理论、影子银行理论、系统性风险理论
AI.method: 反事实法医分析：应用三元逻辑框架对历史失败节点（雷曼兄弟Repo 105、Clayton Holdings豁免贷款、AIG抵押品争议）进行案例分析
AI.findings: 三元架构通过引入"神圣零"状态和"偿付能力协议"，能够结构性防止危机：未经验证资产在加密验证前保持执行暂停状态，从而中和影子银行的传染途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出金融计算架构的范式转变：从二元到三元逻辑；2. 引入"神圣零"作为不确定性计算状态；3. 建立"偿付能力协议"作为系统性风险防控机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融监管提供新的技术框架；2. 为金融系统设计提供架构指导；3. 为风险管理系统提供可操作协议；4. 为金融科技创新提供理论基础

title: Explainable AI-Enhanced Energy Forecasting Using LightGBM with SHAP and LIME Interpretability
affiliations: Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham and Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) - School of Engineering and Technology

detail.title: Explainable AI-Enhanced Energy Forecasting Using LightGBM with SHAP and LIME Interpretability

contentType.other: accepted for conference and we have presented and yet to publish

detail.abstract: Accurate prediction of photovoltaic generation, wind generation, and electric demand is crucial for grid reliability, economic dispatch, and the integration of renewable resources across different operational timeframes. This study proposes a forecasting framework that evaluates multiple machine learning models, including XGBoost, Random Forest, NGBoost, CatBoost, SVR, and KNN, with LightGBM identified as the most effective learner when applied to 5-minute data aggregated into daily intervals. To enhance transparency, Explainable AI techniques are integrated: SHAP quantifies global and local feature contributions, highlighting the influence of lagged signals, while LIME provides case-specific explanations for individual forecasts. The methodology employs chronological data splits with trainonly scaling to preserve the integrity of time-series learning and uses R² and RMSE metrics for evaluation. Results indicate that forecasting performance varies across datasets, underscoring the need for customized models. Comparative analysis confirms that LightGBM achieves the best trade-off between accuracy, stability, and interpretability. By combining robust forecasting with explainable insights, the proposed framework supports AI-enhanced energy management, enabling situational awareness, informed decision-making, and scalable deployment in renewable-rich power systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合机器学习预测与可解释AI的能源预测框架，评估多种模型在光伏、风电和电力需求预测中的表现，发现LightGBM在准确性、稳定性和可解释性方面达到最佳平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既准确又透明的机器学习框架来预测光伏发电、风力发电和电力需求，以支持可再生能源丰富的电力系统管理？
AI.motivation: 准确预测光伏发电、风力发电和电力需求对于电网可靠性、经济调度和可再生能源整合至关重要，但现有预测方法在透明度和可解释性方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习预测理论、可解释人工智能（XAI）、时间序列分析、特征重要性分析（SHAP和LIME方法）
AI.method: 采用多种机器学习模型（XGBoost、Random Forest、NGBoost、CatBoost、SVR、KNN、LightGBM）进行预测，使用5分钟数据聚合为日间隔，采用时间顺序数据分割和训练集缩放，集成SHAP和LIME进行可解释性分析，使用R²和RMSE指标评估性能。
AI.findings: 1. LightGBM在准确性、稳定性和可解释性方面表现最佳；2. 预测性能因数据集而异，需要定制化模型；3. 滞后信号对预测有显著影响；4. 可解释AI技术能有效量化特征贡献并提供案例特定解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合预测准确性和模型可解释性的综合框架；2. 验证了LightGBM在能源时间序列预测中的优越性；3. 展示了SHAP和LIME在能源预测中的实际应用价值；4. 为AI增强的能源管理提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为电力系统运营商提供透明、可解释的预测工具；2. 支持情境感知和知情决策；3. 促进可再生能源丰富电力系统的可扩展部署；4. 为经济调度和电网可靠性提供技术支持。

title: Biases in Belief Updating Within and Across Domains
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Biases in Belief Updating Within and Across Domains
detail.abstract:
Why do people sometimes overreact to new information and other times underreact? We develop a model in which the strength of a signal—how much one should update their beliefs with new information—depends on multiple features of the information environment. Limited attention to these features leads to misperceptions of signal strength: people approach a problem with an experience-based prior, which they adjust only partially based on how much attention they pay to different features. This mechanism explains a wide range of belief-updating patterns. Insensitivity to a single feature generates underreaction to strong and overreaction to weak signals, and more neglected features amplify this. Insensitivity to multiple features can instead break that pattern: insensitivity to one feature can generate excess sensitivity with respect to another, leading to overreaction to both weak and strong signals. A series of experiments provides support for the model and its underlying mechanism.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个模型，解释人们为何有时对新信息反应过度，有时反应不足。关键在于人们对信号强度的感知取决于信息环境的多个特征，而有限注意力导致对这些特征的误判，从而产生不同的信念更新模式。
AI.research_question: 为什么人们有时对新信息反应过度，有时反应不足？
AI.motivation: 理解信念更新中的异质性反应模式，解释现实世界中观察到的过度反应和反应不足现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有限注意力理论，提出信号强度感知模型，强调信息环境的多特征性质如何影响信念更新。
AI.method: 理论模型开发与实验验证相结合的方法。
AI.findings: 1. 对单一特征不敏感会导致对强信号反应不足、对弱信号反应过度；2. 更多被忽视的特征会放大这种模式；3. 对多个特征不敏感可能打破该模式，导致对强弱信号都反应过度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出一个统一框架解释信念更新中的异质性模式；2. 阐明有限注意力如何通过影响信号强度感知来产生反应偏差；3. 揭示多特征信息环境中注意力分配的复杂效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解金融市场中的过度反应和反应不足现象；2. 为决策制定者提供改善信息呈现方式的指导；3. 有助于设计更好的信息传播策略以减少认知偏差。

title: Tariff War Shock and the Convenience Yield of US Treasuries — A Hedging Perspective
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business and New York University (NYU) - Department of Finance

detail.title: Tariff War Shock and the Convenience Yield of US Treasuries — A Hedging Perspective
detail.abstract:
We explain how the “Tariff War” shock of April 2025 affected the safe-asset status of US Treasuries. Convenience yield erosion for long bonds is consistent with a reduction in the hedging property, reflected in a rising stock-bond covariance. Decomposing the Treasury yield into risk-free rate, credit spread, and convenience yield components reveals that covariance due to the convenience yield component increased for long bonds. The short end of the Treasury curve, however, continued to exhibit the safe-asset hedging property. These effects are consistent with a withdrawal of safe-asset investors from long-term Treasuries and a rotation towards shorter-term Treasuries and gold.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 2025年4月"关税战"冲击削弱了美国长期国债的安全资产地位，导致长期国债便利收益率下降，股票-债券协方差上升，投资者从长期国债转向短期国债和黄金。
AI.research_question: "关税战"冲击如何影响美国国债的安全资产地位？特别是对长期国债和短期国债的不同影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解地缘政治冲击（如关税战）对全球安全资产市场的影响，特别是美国国债作为避险资产的地位变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全资产理论、便利收益率理论、资产定价理论、避险资产属性理论
AI.method: 将国债收益率分解为无风险利率、信用利差和便利收益率三个组成部分，分析股票-债券协方差变化
AI.findings: 1. 长期国债的便利收益率下降，避险属性减弱；2. 股票-债券协方差上升；3. 短期国债仍保持避险属性；4. 投资者从长期国债转向短期国债和黄金
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了地缘政治冲击影响安全资产地位的理论解释；2. 深化了对国债收益率分解中便利收益率成分的理解；3. 解释了不同期限国债避险属性的异质性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者在关税战等冲击下的资产配置提供指导；2. 为政策制定者理解国债市场稳定性提供参考；3. 帮助金融机构管理地缘政治风险

title: O-Ring Automation
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: O-Ring Automation
detail.abstract:
We study automation when tasks are quality complements rather than separable. Production requires numerous tasks whose qualities multiply as in an O-ring technology. A worker allocates a fixed endowment of time across the tasks performed; machines can replace tasks with given quality, and time is allocated across the remaining manual tasks. This “focus” mechanism generates three results. First, task-by-task substitution logic is incomplete because automating one task changes the return to automating others. Second, automation decisions are discrete and can require bundled adoption even when automation quality improves smoothly. Third, labour income can rise under partial automation because automation scales the value of remaining bottleneck tasks. These results imply that widely-used exposure indices, which aggregate task-level automation risk using linear formulas, will overstate displacement when tasks are complements. The relevant object is not average task exposure but the structure of bottlenecks and how automation reshapes worker time around them.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究任务质量互补（而非独立）时的自动化问题。生产需要多个任务，其质量像O环技术一样相乘。工人将固定时间分配到各项任务；机器可以替代特定质量的任务，时间则重新分配到剩余人工任务。这种"聚焦"机制产生三个结果：1) 任务间替代逻辑不完整，因为自动化一个任务会影响其他任务的自动化收益；2) 自动化决策是离散的，即使自动化质量平稳提升，也可能需要捆绑采用；3) 部分自动化可能提高劳动收入，因为自动化放大了剩余瓶颈任务的价值。这意味着常用的线性暴露指数会高估替代风险。
AI.research_question: 当生产任务之间存在质量互补关系（而非独立）时，自动化如何影响生产过程和劳动收入？任务间的互补性如何改变自动化决策的逻辑和结果？
AI.motivation: 现有自动化研究通常假设任务是可分离的，但现实生产中许多任务存在质量互补关系（如O环技术）。传统的线性暴露指数可能无法准确评估自动化风险，需要研究任务互补性对自动化决策和劳动力市场的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于O环生产函数理论，任务质量相乘而非相加；"聚焦"机制理论，工人时间重新分配到剩余人工任务；任务互补性理论，自动化一个任务会影响其他任务的边际价值。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含任务质量互补的生产模型，分析工人时间分配、机器替代决策和自动化质量变化的影响机制。
AI.findings: 1) 任务间替代逻辑不完整：自动化一个任务会改变其他任务的自动化收益；2) 自动化决策离散性：即使自动化质量平稳提升，也可能需要捆绑采用；3) 劳动收入可能上升：部分自动化通过放大剩余瓶颈任务的价值提高劳动收入；4) 传统线性暴露指数会高估替代风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了任务质量互补条件下的自动化理论框架；2) 提出了"聚焦"机制作为自动化影响的新渠道；3) 揭示了任务互补性如何改变自动化决策的逻辑；4) 挑战了传统线性暴露指数的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业和政策制定者提供更准确的自动化风险评估框架；2) 指出关注瓶颈任务结构而非平均暴露的重要性；3) 揭示了部分自动化可能提高劳动收入的机制；4) 为自动化投资决策提供理论指导。

title: Valuing Sticky Deposits
affiliations: University of Delaware, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management and University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Finance Area

detail.title: Valuing Sticky Deposits
detail.abstract:
We develop a formal fixed-income framework to value sticky deposits. This framework provides closed-form expressions for deposit values and allows us to study the impact of stickiness on deposit interest-rate and runoff risks. The duration of a bank deposit can be either positive or negative, which has important implications for hedging the interest-rate risk of bank balance sheets. Banks that maximize deposit value by following optimal deposit beta strategies may significantly increase their interest-rate and deposit runoff risks. We test the empirical implications of the valuation model using market deposit premia observed in bank merger/acquisition transactions. The results provide strong empirical support for the model’s predictions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个固定收益框架来评估粘性存款价值，发现存款久期可正可负，这对银行利率风险对冲有重要影响。银行通过最优存款β策略最大化存款价值时可能显著增加利率风险和存款流失风险。
AI.research_question: 如何评估粘性存款的价值？粘性对存款的利率风险和流失风险有何影响？银行如何通过最优存款β策略管理这些风险？
AI.motivation: 银行存款具有粘性特征，传统估值方法难以准确评估其价值。理解存款粘性对利率风险和流失风险的影响对银行风险管理至关重要，特别是在利率环境变化和银行并购交易中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 固定收益定价理论，粘性存款估值模型，存款β策略理论，利率风险对冲理论
AI.method: 开发正式的固定收益框架，推导存款价值的闭式表达式，使用银行并购交易中的市场存款溢价数据进行实证检验
AI.findings: 1. 存款久期可正可负，对银行资产负债表利率风险对冲有重要影响；2. 银行通过最优存款β策略最大化存款价值时，可能显著增加利率风险和存款流失风险；3. 实证结果强烈支持模型预测
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了首个正式的粘性存款估值框架；2. 揭示了存款久期的双重性特征；3. 建立了存款β策略与风险权衡的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行提供了存款价值评估工具；2. 帮助银行更好地管理利率风险和存款流失风险；3. 为银行并购交易中的存款定价提供理论依据

title: Ruling for the Rich: the Supreme Court over Time
affiliations: Columbia University in the City of New York, Yale School of Management and Columbia University

detail.title: Ruling for the Rich: the Supreme Court over Time
detail.abstract:
To investigate the emergence of a pro-wealthy bias in the US Supreme Court, we develop a protocol to identify and analyze all cases involving economic issues from 1953 to the present. We categorize the parties in these cases as “rich” or “poor” according to their likelihood of being wealthy. A vote is pro-rich if that outcome would directly shift resources to the party that is more likely to be wealthy. Using this dataset, we estimate case-specific intercepts, justice-specific latent ideal points, and party-level time trends using the Bayesian methods pioneered by Martin and Quinn (2002). In the 1950s, justices appointed by the two parties appear similar in their propensity to cast pro-rich votes. Over the sample period, we estimate a steady increase in polarization, culminating in an implied party gap of 47 percentage points by 2022. The magnitude of the gap suggests the usefulness of an economic metric for prediction relative to ideologies such as originalism or textualism.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种识别美国最高法院经济案件的方法，发现法官对富人/穷人投票倾向存在党派极化，从1950年代无差异发展到2022年47个百分点的党派差距。
AI.research_question: 美国最高法院是否存在支持富人的偏见？这种偏见如何随时间演变，特别是与法官任命党派的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 研究最高法院在经济案件中的决策模式，了解司法系统是否偏向富裕阶层，以及党派政治如何影响这种偏向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Martin和Quinn（2002）的贝叶斯方法，构建法官潜在理想点模型；使用"富人/穷人"分类框架分析经济资源分配案件。
AI.method: 识别1953年至今所有涉及经济问题的最高法院案件，根据当事人财富可能性分类为"富人"或"穷人"，使用贝叶斯方法估计案件特定截距、法官潜在理想点和党派时间趋势。
AI.findings: 1950年代两党任命的法官在支持富人投票倾向上相似；随时间推移极化加剧，到2022年党派差距达到47个百分点；经济指标比原旨主义或文本主义等意识形态更有预测价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了系统分析最高法院经济案件偏向的方法论框架；揭示了司法决策中党派极化的长期趋势；提供了衡量司法偏向的经济指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估最高法院公正性提供实证依据；帮助预测未来经济案件判决结果；为司法改革和法官任命提供参考。

title: Renewable Energy Expansion: Key Challenges and Emerging Opportunities
affiliations: University of Chicago

detail.title: Renewable Energy Expansion: Key Challenges and Emerging Opportunities
detail.abstract:
The global expansion of renewable energy is key to addressing climate change. After a decade of dramatic cost reductions—especially for solar photovoltaics and wind—renewables now approach cost parity with fossil generation. While this cost reduction has led to a steep increase in solar and wind power in several countries, the global share of solar and wind generation remains modest—approximately 15% as of 2023. This article reviews recent economic studies and identifies three central challenges and corresponding opportunities for scaling up renewable energy—underdeveloped regulatory and market design, insufficient intertemporal market integration, and inadequate spatial market integration. The insights from this review highlight effective ways to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了可再生能源扩张的经济研究，识别了三个核心挑战：监管与市场设计不完善、时间市场整合不足、空间市场整合不足，并提出了相应的机遇以加速全球能源转型。
AI.research_question: 尽管可再生能源成本大幅下降，为何其全球份额仍然有限？如何通过经济政策解决可再生能源扩张面临的挑战？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源对应对气候变化至关重要，虽然太阳能和风能成本大幅下降，但全球份额仍只有15%左右，需要识别阻碍因素并找到解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能源经济学、市场设计理论和系统集成理论，分析可再生能源扩张的经济障碍。
AI.method: 文献综述法，回顾近期经济研究，识别关键挑战和机遇。
AI.findings: 识别了三个核心挑战：1) 监管与市场设计不完善；2) 时间市场整合不足；3) 空间市场整合不足，并提出了相应的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 为可再生能源经济学提供了系统性的分析框架，整合了市场设计、时间整合和空间整合三个维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的政策建议，包括改进监管框架、加强储能和电网互联等，以加速可再生能源部署。

title: Market Power and Capital Constraints
affiliations: and Wisconsin School of Business

detail.title: Market Power and Capital Constraints
detail.abstract:
We explore how traders' equity capitalization influences asset prices in a framework that accounts for market power. In our model, traders with capital constraints engage in transactions in an imperfectly competitive market. We demonstrate that looser capital constraints elevate both asset prices and price impact, the latter diminishing market liquidity. Using Canadian Treasury auction data, we illustrate how to apply our model to quantify these effects. We estimate the shadow costs of capital constraints by leveraging a temporary policy exemption during 2020-2021. We show that while these constraints are only infrequently binding, their relative impact when activated can be sizable.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了交易者资本约束如何影响资产价格和市场流动性，发现资本约束放松会推高资产价格和价格影响，降低市场流动性。利用加拿大国债拍卖数据和疫情期间政策豁免，量化了资本约束的隐性成本。
AI.research_question: 交易者的资本约束如何影响资产价格、价格影响和市场流动性？
AI.motivation: 理解市场不完全竞争环境下，交易者资本约束对资产定价和市场流动性的影响机制，为政策制定和市场监管提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不完全竞争市场框架，考虑交易者资本约束和市场力量，构建资产定价模型。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析：1）建立包含资本约束的不完全竞争市场模型；2）利用加拿大国债拍卖数据进行实证检验；3）借助2020-2021年临时政策豁免估计资本约束的隐性成本。
AI.findings: 1）资本约束放松会同时提高资产价格和价格影响；2）价格影响增加会降低市场流动性；3）虽然资本约束不经常约束交易者，但一旦被激活，其相对影响可能相当显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将资本约束纳入不完全竞争市场框架，丰富了资产定价理论；2）揭示了资本约束通过价格影响渠道影响市场流动性的机制；3）提供了量化资本约束隐性成本的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为监管机构评估资本约束政策效果提供分析工具；2）帮助市场参与者理解资本约束对交易策略的影响；3）利用加拿大国债拍卖案例展示了模型的实际应用价值。

title: Entry and Exit in Treasury Auctions
affiliations: Wisconsin School of Business, University of Chicago, University of Chicago - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Entry and Exit in Treasury Auctions
detail.abstract:
Hedge funds have become increasingly active in Treasury markets, yet we have little evidence on how this shift has affected the market. We focus on the primary market, where the government issues its debt through auctions. Using over 20 years of data from Canadian Treasury auctions, we document dealers exiting and hedge funds entering. To evaluate the costs and benefits of this trend for debt issuance, we develop an auction framework with endogenous participation. We find that the expected gains from greater hedge fund participation, driven by increased competition, are smaller than the costs that arise because hedge funds—unlike dealers—do not participate regularly. Currently, dealer participation remains sufficiently strong that policies aimed at stabilizing participation have little effect on funding costs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了加拿大国债拍卖市场中交易商退出、对冲基金进入的趋势，发现对冲基金参与带来的竞争收益小于其不规律参与带来的成本，目前交易商参与度仍足够强，稳定参与的政策对融资成本影响有限。
AI.research_question: 对冲基金在国债拍卖市场中的参与如何影响政府债务发行的成本和效益？
AI.motivation: 对冲基金在国债市场中日益活跃，但缺乏证据表明这种转变如何影响市场。特别关注一级市场（政府通过拍卖发行债务），需要评估这一趋势对债务发行的成本和效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生参与拍卖框架，分析市场参与者（交易商与对冲基金）的不同参与模式对拍卖结果的影响。
AI.method: 使用20多年的加拿大国债拍卖数据，记录交易商退出和对冲基金进入的趋势。开发内生参与拍卖模型来评估这一趋势的成本和效益。
AI.findings: 1. 交易商退出、对冲基金进入的趋势明显；2. 对冲基金参与带来的预期收益（来自竞争增加）小于其不规律参与带来的成本；3. 目前交易商参与度仍足够强，稳定参与的政策对融资成本影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了内生参与拍卖框架，为分析市场参与者结构变化对拍卖结果的影响提供了理论工具，特别关注参与者参与规律性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于国债拍卖市场参与者结构变化的成本效益分析，表明当前阶段稳定参与的政策对降低融资成本效果有限，有助于制定更有效的债务发行策略。

title: The Morality Of Market Exchanges: Between Societal Values And Trade-Offs
affiliations: University of CEMA, University of Bologna and Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School

detail.title: The Morality Of Market Exchanges: Between Societal Values And Trade-Offs
detail.abstract:
Onychomycosis is most commonly caused by dermatophytes, but non-dermatophytic fungi are increasingly recognized as relevant pathogens, especially in immunocompromised patients. We report a rare case of mixed onychomycosis caused by two non-dermatophytic molds. Cultures on Sabouraud Dextrose Agar revealed two distinct colonies, subsequently identified as Purpureocillium lilacinum by microscopic morphology and Fusarium solani by EUROArray Dermatomycosis assay and characteristic macroconidia. This co-infection highlights the pathogenic potential of non-dermatophytic fungi often considered contaminants. Both species exhibit poor susceptibility to conventional antifungals, complicating treatment. The case emphasizes the importance of integrated mycological and molecular diagnostics in atypical onychomycosis.

Certain behaviors in markets are unambiguously unethical. In other cases, however, voluntary exchanges that can create gains from trade remain contested on moral grounds, because of what is traded or of the price at which the exchange occurs. This chapter offers a framework to analyze these contested markets and provides examples of two general instances. First, we examine “repugnant” transactions involving the human body—such as compensated organ donation and gestational surrogacy—where concerns about dignity, exploitation, and inequality conflict with welfare gains from expanding supply. Second, we study price gouging in emergencies, where demands for a “just price” clash with the incentive and allocation roles of price adjustments under scarcity. Across both cases, we synthesize evidence on societal attitudes and highlight how support for policy options depends on perceived trade-offs between autonomy, fairness and efficiency, and on institutional features that can separate compensation from allocation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个分析争议性市场的框架，重点关注人体器官交易和紧急情况下的价格欺诈两个案例，探讨了自主权、公平与效率之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 如何分析那些在道德上存在争议的市场交易？这些争议性市场中的政策选择如何受到自主权、公平和效率之间权衡的影响？
AI.motivation: 某些市场交易虽然能创造贸易收益，但因交易内容或价格而在道德上受到争议，需要系统性的分析框架来理解这些争议的本质和政策选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于道德哲学、经济学和社会心理学，构建了分析争议性市场的框架，重点关注自主权、公平和效率三个核心价值之间的权衡。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与案例分析相结合的方法，通过两个具体案例（人体器官交易和紧急价格欺诈）来验证和阐述理论框架。
AI.findings: 1. 争议性市场的政策支持取决于对自主权、公平和效率之间权衡的认知；2. 制度设计可以将补偿与分配分离，从而缓解道德困境；3. 社会态度在不同情境下对争议性交易的反应存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个系统性的分析框架来理解争议性市场的道德困境，整合了经济学、伦理学和社会心理学的视角，为研究道德边界上的市场交易提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估争议性市场政策的实用框架，帮助设计既能尊重道德关切又能实现效率的制度安排，特别是在器官移植和紧急物资分配等领域。

title: Bayesian Inference in IV Regressions
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, European Central Bank (ECB) and Northwestern University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Bayesian Inference in IV Regressions
detail.abstract:
It is well known that standard frequentist inference breaks down in IV regressions with weak instruments. Bayesian inference with diffuse priors suffers from the same problem. We show that the issue arises because flat priors on the first-stage coefficients overstate instrument strength. In contrast, inference improves drastically when an uninformative prior is specified directly on the concentration parameter—the key nuisance parameter capturing instrument relevance. The resulting Bayesian credible intervals are asymptotically equivalent to the frequentist confidence intervals based on conditioning approaches, and remain robust to weak instruments.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，在弱工具变量情况下，传统的频率推断和扩散先验贝叶斯推断都会失效。作者发现问题的根源在于对第一阶段系数的平坦先验会高估工具变量强度。相反，如果直接在浓度参数（衡量工具变量相关性的关键参数）上设定无信息先验，推断效果会显著改善。这种贝叶斯可信区间与基于条件方法的频率置信区间渐近等价，且对弱工具变量具有稳健性。
AI.research_question: 在工具变量回归中，当工具变量较弱时，如何构建稳健的统计推断方法？具体而言，如何通过改进贝叶斯先验设定来解决弱工具变量问题？
AI.motivation: 在工具变量回归中，当工具变量较弱时，传统的频率推断方法会失效。同样，使用扩散先验的贝叶斯推断也存在相同问题。这在实际应用中是一个严重问题，因为弱工具变量情况在实证研究中很常见。作者旨在解决这一长期存在的统计推断难题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工具变量回归理论、贝叶斯推断理论、弱工具变量理论、浓度参数理论。论文基于工具变量回归的统计框架，特别关注弱工具变量情况下的推断问题。
AI.method: 理论分析方法。作者通过理论推导证明，对第一阶段系数使用平坦先验会高估工具变量强度，导致推断失效。相反，直接在浓度参数上设定无信息先验可以显著改善推断效果。论文进行了渐近理论分析，比较了不同先验设定下的推断性质。
AI.findings:
1. 对第一阶段系数的平坦先验会高估工具变量强度，这是导致弱工具变量情况下推断失效的根本原因。
2. 直接在浓度参数上设定无信息先验可以显著改善推断效果。
3. 基于浓度参数无信息先验的贝叶斯可信区间与基于条件方法的频率置信区间渐近等价。
4. 这种方法对弱工具变量具有稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了弱工具变量问题在贝叶斯推断中的根源：对第一阶段系数的平坦先验会高估工具变量强度。
2. 提出了解决弱工具变量问题的新方法：直接在浓度参数上设定无信息先验。
3. 建立了贝叶斯可信区间与频率置信区间在弱工具变量情况下的渐近等价关系。
4. 为工具变量回归提供了理论上的稳健推断框架。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为实证研究者提供了在弱工具变量情况下进行稳健统计推断的实用方法。
2. 该方法易于实现，只需要改变先验设定的参数化方式。
3. 解决了实际研究中常见的弱工具变量问题，提高了推断的可靠性。
4. 为贝叶斯工具变量分析提供了具体的先验设定指导。

title: Real Sector Neglect Hypothesis: An Alternative Lens to Understand the Economic Crisis

detail.title: Real Sector Neglect Hypothesis: An Alternative Lens to Understand the Economic Crisis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest in this article.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Rinaldi & Co. Research Society Center.

detail.abstract: This study investigates whether a consistent, underlying pattern connects major economic crises, specifically, the decline of the real economy sector (agriculture and industry) alongside excessive financialization and service-sector expansion. Through a qualitative case study approach, we analyze historical GDP and sectoral data from four pivotal crises: the Great Depression, the European Debt Crisis, the Subprime Mortgage Crisis, and Sri Lanka's Economic Crisis. Our findings reveal a recurring structural vulnerability: each crisis was preceded by (1) declining productivity in the real sector, (2) a shift away from industrial and agricultural foundations, and (3) unsustainable growth in finance and services. These trends suggest that economic fragility arises not just from financial mismanagement but from deeper imbalances, where economies prioritize speculative and non-productive sectors over tangible value creation. This research contributes to crisis economics by proposing the Real Sector Neglect Hypothesis (RSNH), which reframes systemic collapses as structural, not only than purely cyclical or policy-driven, failures. The policy implication is clear: sustainable growth requires rebalancing toward productive sectors to enhance resilience against future shocks.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析四次重大经济危机，发现危机前都存在实体经济衰退、金融化和服务业过度扩张的共同模式，提出了"实体经济忽视假说"，认为系统性崩溃是结构性而非纯粹周期性或政策驱动的失败。
AI.research_question: 是否存在一个一致的潜在模式连接主要经济危机，即实体经济部门（农业和工业）衰退与过度金融化和服务业扩张同时发生？
AI.motivation: 理解经济危机的深层结构性原因，超越传统的金融管理不善解释，探索实体经济部门衰退与金融化之间的系统性联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 危机经济学、结构失衡理论、实体经济忽视假说（RSNH）、金融化理论
AI.method: 定性案例研究方法，分析四次关键危机的历史GDP和部门数据：大萧条、欧洲债务危机、次贷危机和斯里兰卡经济危机
AI.findings: 发现反复出现的结构性脆弱性：每次危机前都出现(1)实体经济部门生产率下降，(2)脱离工业和农业基础，(3)金融和服务业不可持续增长。这些趋势表明经济脆弱性不仅源于金融管理不善，还源于更深层次的不平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"实体经济忽视假说"（RSNH），将系统性崩溃重新定义为结构性而非纯粹周期性或政策驱动的失败，为危机经济学提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示明确：可持续增长需要向生产性部门重新平衡，以增强对未来冲击的抵御能力。为政策制定者提供了预防经济危机的结构性调整方向。

title: Self- and Social Signaling: Evidence from Solar Adoption in California
affiliations: Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business, Yale University and Michigan State University

detail.title: Self- and Social Signaling: Evidence from Solar Adoption in California
detail.abstract:
Prosocial behavior plays a role in many economic contexts, and it has been explained by altruism, social pressure, signaling, and expectations of fairness and reciprocity. We examine prosocial behavior in a context that allows us to distinguish the role of self-signaling and social signaling from alternative explanations, including warm glow. Our context is residential solar, and self-signaling is separately identified from social signaling by the exogenous visibility of potential solar arrays. We show that the political affiliation of proximate peers influences the extent of self-signaling and is crowded out by the private benefits of installing solar.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过住宅太阳能安装场景，区分了自我信号与社会信号对亲社会行为的影响，发现邻近同伴的政治倾向会影响自我信号效应，且私人收益会挤出自我信号动机。
AI.research_question: 在亲社会行为中，自我信号和社会信号如何分别影响决策？邻近同伴的政治倾向如何调节这些信号效应？私人收益如何与信号动机相互作用？
AI.motivation: 亲社会行为在经济决策中普遍存在，但现有解释（利他主义、社会压力、信号传递、公平互惠预期）难以区分自我信号和社会信号的作用。住宅太阳能安装场景提供了独特机会，因为太阳能板的可见性可以外生地识别这两种信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亲社会行为理论、信号理论（自我信号与社会信号）、社会影响理论、政治认同理论、动机挤出效应
AI.method: 利用住宅太阳能安装的自然实验，通过太阳能板的外生可见性来识别自我信号与社会信号。分析邻近同伴的政治倾向对自我信号的影响，以及私人收益对信号动机的挤出效应。
AI.findings: 1. 邻近同伴的政治倾向显著影响自我信号效应；2. 私人收益会挤出自我信号动机；3. 在住宅太阳能决策中，自我信号和社会信号都是重要的驱动因素，但作用机制不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在亲社会行为研究中首次清晰区分自我信号与社会信号；2. 揭示了政治认同如何调节信号效应；3. 扩展了动机挤出理论在环境决策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计促进可再生能源采用的政策提供理论依据；2. 帮助企业理解消费者环保决策的心理机制；3. 为社区推广太阳能提供基于社会网络的策略建议。

title: Green Waste
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics, University of Chicago, Ohio State University (OSU) - Fisher College of Business and University of Chicago

detail.title: Green Waste
detail.abstract:
We test for and measure green waste: the misallocation of public subsidies for green investment projects. Our context is a major Norwegian program for green investment subsidies. We develop a model of subsidy allocation and apply it to detailed project-level data on carbon emissions and subsidy amounts for both marginal and inframarginal projects. We find that decision-makers could have achieved the same level of emission reductions at less than half the cost. To isolate the sources of this green waste, we use data on both ex-ante expected and ex-post realized emission reductions for each project. We find that decision-makers are able ex-ante to identify the projects with the highest ex-post emission reductions but unwilling to select them.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 挪威绿色投资补贴项目中存在显著的"绿色浪费"现象，决策者本可以用不到一半的成本实现相同的减排目标，但未能选择最具成本效益的项目。
AI.research_question: 挪威绿色投资补贴项目中是否存在"绿色浪费"（补贴错配）？其来源是什么？
AI.motivation: 公共补贴对绿色投资至关重要，但补贴分配效率如何尚不清楚。需要评估绿色投资补贴是否存在浪费，并识别其根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 补贴分配模型，结合边际和次边际项目分析，考虑事前预期和事后实际减排效果。
AI.method: 开发补贴分配模型，应用于挪威绿色投资补贴项目的详细项目级数据，包括碳排放量和补贴金额，分析边际和次边际项目。
AI.findings: 1. 决策者本可以用不到一半的成本实现相同减排目标；2. 决策者能够事前识别减排效果最好的项目，但不愿意选择这些项目。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"绿色浪费"概念，建立了评估绿色投资补贴效率的分析框架，揭示了补贴分配中的决策偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改进绿色投资补贴分配效率的具体方向，建议更注重成本效益分析，减少补贴浪费。

title: What Are the Benefits of Metro Rail in Mumbai, India?
affiliations: West Virginia University and Department of Economics

detail.title: What Are the Benefits of Metro Rail in Mumbai, India?
detail.abstract:
We estimate the effects of the first metro rail line in Mumbai using administrative data on assessed property prices from 2011-18 for 723 subzones in the city. Comparing areas within 1 km of the metro with those beyond 1 km but within 3 km, we estimate the effects on property values for commercial, industrial, and residential properties. We find a significant and persistent increase in prices of 6-8% for residential and commercial land use categories in treated areas relative to control areas after Metro Line 1 opens. We show that commute time savings and improvements in employment accessibility are plausible mechanisms underlying these effects.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 使用孟买2011-18年723个分区的房产评估价格数据，研究发现第一条地铁线路开通后，距离地铁1公里内的住宅和商业地产价格相比1-3公里外的区域上涨6-8%，通勤时间节省和就业可达性改善是主要机制。
AI.research_question: 孟买第一条地铁线路对商业、工业和住宅地产价值的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解公共交通基础设施投资对城市房地产价值的影响，特别是在发展中国家大城市的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交通基础设施经济学理论，特别是公共交通改善对房地产价值的影响机制，包括通勤时间节省和就业可达性改善。
AI.method: 使用2011-18年孟买723个分区的行政房产评估价格数据，采用准实验设计，比较距离地铁1公里内区域（处理组）与1-3公里外区域（控制组）的房产价格变化。
AI.findings: 地铁1号线开通后，处理区域的住宅和商业地产价格相比控制区域显著且持续上涨6-8%，工业地产影响不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家大城市公共交通基础设施对房地产价值的影响提供了实证证据，验证了通勤时间节省和就业可达性改善作为影响机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划和交通基础设施投资决策提供依据，帮助政策制定者评估公共交通项目的经济效益，特别是对房地产市场的溢出效应。

title: Payroll Digitalization and Financial Inclusion: Lessons from Islamic and Conventional Banking for the U.S. Market
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Payroll Digitalization and Financial Inclusion: Lessons from Islamic and Conventional Banking for the U.S. Market

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non‑financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants or identifiable data
declarations.funderStatement: No External Funding

detail.abstract: Financial inclusion is widely recognized as a foundation for economic resilience and social stability. In the United States, a significant share of households remain unbanked or underbanked and continue to rely on cash, check-cashers, and high-cost alternative financial services for everyday transactions. This paper examines how payroll digitalization and employee banking platforms can support underbanked workers and contribute to financial inclusion in the U.S. context. Drawing on practices observed in Islamic and conventional banking markets, the paper argues that employer-linked payroll systems, supported by digital onboarding and Shariah-informed design principles, can create effective pathways into formal finance for low-income and vulnerable workers. The analysis is informed by international research and policy guidance from the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund (IMF), and the U.S. Treasury. The paper outlines the role of employee banking as a channel for inclusion, highlights the importance of digital tools such as tablet-based account opening and mobile banking, and explores how Islamic finance principles can enhance trust and consumer protection. It concludes with practical recommendations for U.S. financial institutions and policymakers seeking to expand access while maintaining strong standards of compliance and risk management.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了美国背景下，工资数字化和员工银行平台如何支持银行服务不足的工人并促进金融包容性。论文借鉴伊斯兰和传统银行市场的实践，认为雇主关联的工资系统结合数字化入职和伊斯兰教法设计原则，可以为低收入和弱势工人创造进入正规金融的有效途径。
AI.research_question: 工资数字化和员工银行平台如何支持美国银行服务不足的工人并促进金融包容性？
AI.motivation: 美国仍有大量家庭处于无银行账户或银行服务不足状态，依赖现金、支票兑现商和高成本的替代金融服务进行日常交易，这影响了经济韧性和社会稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、伊斯兰金融原则（特别是伊斯兰教法设计原则）、数字金融理论、雇主关联金融渠道理论。
AI.method: 基于国际研究和政策指导的分析方法，借鉴世界银行、国际货币基金组织和美国财政部的政策指导，分析伊斯兰和传统银行市场的实践案例。
AI.findings: 雇主关联的工资系统结合数字化工具（如平板电脑开户和移动银行）可以有效促进金融包容性；伊斯兰金融原则可以增强信任和消费者保护；员工银行是重要的包容渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 将伊斯兰金融原则应用于美国金融包容性问题的理论扩展；提出雇主关联工资系统作为金融包容性新途径的理论框架；整合数字工具与传统金融渠道的理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国金融机构和政策制定者提供实践建议：推广数字化入职工具、采用伊斯兰教法设计原则增强信任、加强合规和风险管理标准、建立雇主-银行合作模式。

title: The Bureaucratic Reliability Trap: Political Oversight and the Persistence of Corruption
affiliations: Department of Political Science, Yale University

detail.title: The Bureaucratic Reliability Trap: Political Oversight and the Persistence of Corruption
detail.abstract: Standard principal-agent models of corruption typically assume a benevolent principal monitoring a potential rogue agent. This paper relaxes that assumption to analyze bureaucratic reliability under dishonest political principals. Developing an infinite-horizon game of political oversight, I demonstrate that the shadow of the future acts as a double-edged sword: it resolves the commitment problem for honest principals to enforce reliability, but simultaneously empowers dishonest principals to enforce corruption via credible threats of permanent career derailment. Extending the analysis to endogenous rent-sharing, I find that standard anti-corruption parameters yield perverse outcomes under a dishonest principal: "cleaner" bureaucratic pools paradoxically strengthen the bargaining position of corrupt incumbents, while administrative penalties function as leverage for rent extraction rather than deterrence. Finally, the model characterizes a "Bureaucratic Reliability Trap" in which dishonest regimes induce path dependence by systematically purging public-minded agents, thereby entrenching corruption beyond the tenure of the original principal.

AI.tldr: 本文通过无限期界博弈模型分析腐败官僚体系，发现未来预期对诚实和不诚实政治领导产生双重效应：诚实领导能借此建立可靠官僚体系，而不诚实领导则能利用永久职业威胁强制腐败。模型还揭示了标准反腐措施在不诚实领导下的反常效果，并提出了"官僚可靠性陷阱"概念。
AI.research_question: 在不诚实政治领导监督下，官僚体系的可靠性如何形成？标准反腐措施在腐败政权下会产生何种反常效果？
AI.motivation: 传统委托-代理腐败模型假设委托人（政治领导）是仁慈的，但现实中政治领导本身可能不诚实。需要分析在这种情况下的官僚体系动态和反腐政策的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限期界博弈理论、委托-代理理论、政治经济学、腐败经济学、可信承诺理论
AI.method: 建立无限期界博弈模型分析政治监督下的官僚行为，考虑诚实和不诚实两种政治领导类型，并扩展分析内生的租金分享机制
AI.findings: 1. 未来预期是双刃剑：帮助诚实领导建立可靠官僚体系，但让不诚实领导能通过永久职业威胁强制腐败。2. 标准反腐措施在不诚实领导下产生反常效果：更"干净"的官僚池反而增强腐败在位者的议价地位，行政惩罚成为租金提取工具而非威慑。3. 存在"官僚可靠性陷阱"：不诚实政权系统性清除有公共精神的官员，使腐败超越原领导任期而固化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展传统腐败模型，纳入不诚实政治领导。2. 提出未来预期的双重效应理论。3. 揭示反腐措施在腐败政权下的反常机制。4. 提出"官僚可靠性陷阱"概念，解释腐败的路径依赖。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示在腐败政权下标准反腐措施可能适得其反。2. 强调政治领导质量对反腐成功的关键作用。3. 为国际反腐援助提供理论指导：需考虑政治环境。4. 为制度设计者提供避免"官僚可靠性陷阱"的政策建议。

title: Digital Incentives in Surveys: Response Rates and Sociodemographic Effects in a Large-Scale Parental Nudge Intervention
affiliations: Texas A&M University - George Bush School of Government and Public Service, Texas A&M University - George Bush School of Government and Public Service, Texas A&M University and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Digital Incentives in Surveys: Response Rates and Sociodemographic Effects in a Large-Scale Parental Nudge Intervention
detail.abstract:
This study examines how digital incentives influence survey participation and engagement in a large randomized controlled trial of parents across seven Texas school districts. We test how incentive amount and information about vendor options affect response behavior and explore differences by language background. Incentivized parents were more likely to start and complete surveys and claim gift cards, though Spanish-speaking parents exhibited distinct patterns—greater completion rates but lower redemption rates, often selecting essential-goods vendors. Increasing incentive value and providing advance information both improved engagement. Findings inform the design of equitable, effective digital incentive strategies for diverse populations.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过德克萨斯州七个学区的家长随机对照试验，探讨数字激励如何影响调查参与度。研究发现激励金额和供应商信息都会提高参与度，但西班牙语家长表现出不同的行为模式：完成率更高但兑换率更低，更倾向于选择必需品供应商。
AI.research_question: 数字激励（激励金额和供应商信息）如何影响不同语言背景家长的调查参与行为和礼品卡兑换行为？
AI.motivation: 随着数字调查的普及，如何设计有效的激励策略以提高参与度，特别是针对不同语言和文化背景的多样化人群，成为重要研究问题。需要了解激励因素如何影响不同群体的参与行为，以实现更公平有效的调查设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学中的激励理论、信息不对称理论，以及跨文化沟通和参与行为差异的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用大规模随机对照试验方法，在德克萨斯州七个学区的家长中进行实验，测试不同激励金额和供应商信息对调查参与行为的影响，并比较英语和西班牙语家长的行为差异。
AI.findings: 1. 激励显著提高家长开始和完成调查的可能性，以及礼品卡兑换率；2. 西班牙语家长表现出独特模式：完成率更高但兑换率更低，更倾向于选择必需品供应商；3. 增加激励金额和提前提供供应商信息都能提高参与度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了数字激励理论，揭示了激励在不同语言文化群体中的差异化效果；2. 深化了对信息不对称在激励设计中的作用理解；3. 为跨文化行为经济学提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为调查设计者提供针对多样化人群的公平有效激励策略；2. 建议针对不同语言群体设计差异化的激励方案；3. 强调提供供应商信息的重要性以提高参与度；4. 为教育机构和政策制定者提供实用的调查参与提升方案。

title: Work from Home and the Narrative Reporting Quality
affiliations: and Bayes Business School, City University London

detail.title: Work from Home and the Narrative Reporting Quality
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of work-from-home (WFH) intensity on the narrative reporting quality. We use the city-level intensity of remote work job advertisements as a measure of exogenous pressure on firms to offer WFH opportunities to employees and find that firms headquartered in high-WFH pressure areas issue longer and more complex 10K filings. Occupational data analysis reveals that the effect is stronger when the share of remote work for financial specialists' positions increases, which suggests that the findings capture the difficulty in coordinating the preparation of financial statements among geographically distributed employees. Further tests indicate that the effect is not attributable to lower productivity among employees working from home, lower earnings quality, or declining financial performance. The effect is moderated when employees have more developed online social networks, and when employees are more likely to use AI for their tasks. Overall, the study identifies WFH intensity as a novel organizational determinant of disclosure quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了远程工作强度对叙事报告质量的影响。研究发现，位于高远程工作压力地区的公司发布的10K文件更长更复杂，这种效应在财务专家远程工作比例增加时更明显，表明地理分散的员工协调财务报告编制存在困难。这种效应并非由员工生产力下降、盈余质量降低或财务表现恶化引起，而是受员工在线社交网络发展和AI使用倾向的调节。
AI.research_question: 远程工作强度如何影响公司的叙事报告质量？
AI.motivation: 随着远程工作成为常态，需要了解这种工作模式对财务报告质量的影响，特别是地理分散的员工如何协调复杂的财务报告编制工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织协调理论、信息披露理论和远程工作对组织沟通影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用城市层面的远程工作招聘广告强度作为外生压力指标，分析公司总部所在地与10K文件质量的关系；通过职业数据分析财务专家远程工作比例的影响；进行排除性测试排除其他解释因素。
AI.findings: 1. 高远程工作压力地区的公司发布更长更复杂的10K文件；2. 财务专家远程工作比例增加时效应更强；3. 效应不是由员工生产力下降、盈余质量降低或财务表现恶化引起；4. 员工在线社交网络发展和AI使用倾向会调节这种效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别远程工作强度作为信息披露质量的新组织决定因素；扩展了组织协调理论在远程工作环境下的应用；为地理分散团队的信息披露质量研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公司在实施远程工作政策时如何维持财务报告质量提供指导；建议公司投资员工在线社交网络建设和AI工具使用；为监管机构评估远程工作环境下的信息披露质量提供参考。

title: Revaluing Consumer City: Amenity Usage and Housing Price Capitalization
affiliations: University College London

detail.title: Revaluing Consumer City: Amenity Usage and Housing Price Capitalization
detail.abstract: The Consumer City framework argues that urban growth is driven by access to diverse consumption opportunities rather than workplace proximity. Yet spatial proximity does not necessarily imply actual usage, especially in the work-from-home era, when mobility patterns have been fundamentally reshaped across urban space. We introduce the concept of the Amenity City, defined not by the presence of amenities but by their realized use. Drawing on 260 million anonymized mobile-phone records across England and Wales, we construct high-resolution measures of amenity-visit density at the 0.01 km² grid level in March 2020 and March 2021, and link them to 1.3 million repeat-sales housing transactions. Our analyses show that increases in amenity usage were rapidly capitalized into housing prices, with effects that became even stronger in the post-pandemic period. A spatial difference-indifferences design and event study analysis further reveals that neighborhoods with larger increases in amenity visits saw persistent appreciation in housing prices. We extend the Consumer City framework by demonstrating that not only proximity to amenities but also their actual use is capitalized into property values, providing implications for future research on human mobility and urban value.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"便利设施城市"概念，强调便利设施的实际使用而非单纯空间邻近性驱动城市增长。基于英国手机数据和房产交易分析，发现便利设施使用增加会迅速资本化到房价中，且疫情后效应更强。
AI.research_question: 便利设施的实际使用（而非单纯空间邻近性）是否以及如何资本化到住房价格中？
AI.motivation: 传统"消费城市"框架强调空间邻近性驱动城市增长，但在远程办公时代，空间邻近不一定转化为实际使用，需要重新审视便利设施价值评估方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费城市框架、便利设施资本化理论、空间经济学、人类流动性理论
AI.method: 使用英国2.6亿匿名手机记录构建0.01平方公里网格级别的便利设施访问密度测量，结合130万重复销售住房交易数据，采用空间双重差分设计和事件研究分析
AI.findings: 便利设施使用增加会迅速资本化到房价中，疫情后效应更强；便利设施访问增长更大的社区房价持续升值
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展消费城市框架，提出"便利设施城市"概念，强调实际使用而非单纯空间邻近性的重要性，为人类流动性和城市价值研究提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者、房地产开发商和投资者提供基于实际使用数据的决策依据，帮助理解后疫情时代城市空间价值变化规律

title: Strategic Expression, Popularity Traps, and Welfare in Social Media
affiliations: University of Glasgow and Universite du Luxembourg - Luxembourg School of Finance

detail.title: Strategic Expression, Popularity Traps, and Welfare in Social Media
detail.abstract: Social media platforms systematically reward popularity but not authenticity, incentivizing users to strategically tailor their expression for attention. We develop a utilitarian framework addressing strategic expression in social media. Agents hold fixed heterogeneous authentic opinions and derive (i) utility gains from the popularity of their own posts-measured by likes received, and (ii) utility gains (losses) from exposure to content that aligns with (diverges from) their authentic opinion. Social media interaction acts as a state-dependent welfare amplifier: light topics generate Pareto improvements, whereas intense topics make everyone worse off in a polarized society (e.g., political debates during elections). Moreover, strategic expression amplifies social media polarization during polarized events while dampening it during unified events (e.g., national celebrations). Consequently, strategic distortions magnify welfare outcomes, expanding aggregate gains in light topics while exacerbating losses in intense, polarized ones. Counterintuitively, strategic agents often face a popularity trap: posting a more popular opinion is individually optimal, yet collective action by similar agents eliminates their authentic opinion from the platform, leaving them worse off than under the authentic-expression benchmark. Preference-based algorithms-widely used by platforms-or homophilic exposures discipline popularity-driven behavior, narrowing the popularity trap region and limiting its welfare effects. Our framework fills a critical gap in the social media literature by providing a microfoundation for user welfare that maps to observable metrics, while also introducing popularity incentives as an unexplored channel in social networks distinct from the canonical mechanisms of conformity, learning, persuasion, and (mis)information transmission.

AI.tldr: 社交媒体平台系统性地奖励流行度而非真实性，激励用户为获取关注而策略性地调整表达。该研究开发了一个功利主义框架分析社交媒体中的策略性表达，发现策略性表达在轻松话题中改善福利，但在激烈话题中加剧极化并损害福利，同时揭示了"流行度陷阱"现象。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体中用户的策略性表达如何影响个体福利和社会极化？策略性表达在不同类型话题（轻松vs激烈）中会产生怎样的不同效果？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体平台通过点赞等机制奖励流行度而非真实性，这激励用户为获取关注而策略性地调整表达。现有文献缺乏对这一现象的系统性分析，特别是对用户福利和极化影响的微观基础研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功利主义框架：用户持有固定的异质性真实观点，从自己帖子的流行度（点赞数）获得效用，也从接触与自己观点一致/分歧的内容中获得效用增益/损失。社交媒体互动作为状态依赖的福利放大器。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：开发了一个包含异质性真实观点、策略性表达决策、社交媒体互动机制的数学模型。分析不同话题类型（轻松vs激烈）下的均衡结果和福利效应。
AI.findings: 1. 轻松话题产生帕累托改进，而激烈话题（如选举期间的政治辩论）在极化社会中使所有人福利恶化；2. 策略性表达在极化事件中放大社交媒体极化，在统一事件中减弱极化；3. 策略性扭曲放大福利结果，扩大轻松话题的总收益，加剧激烈极化话题的损失；4. 存在"流行度陷阱"：发布更受欢迎的观点对个体最优，但集体行动会消除真实观点，使用户福利低于真实表达基准。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为社交媒体用户福利提供了可观测指标的微观基础；2. 将流行度激励作为社交网络中区别于传统机制（从众、学习、说服、信息传播）的新渠道；3. 填补了社交媒体文献中关于策略性表达和福利效应的关键空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示了基于偏好的算法和同质化接触可以约束流行度驱动行为，缩小流行度陷阱范围并限制其福利效应；2. 为平台设计提供了洞见：在激烈话题中需要特别关注策略性表达带来的极化放大效应；3. 帮助理解社交媒体在重大社会事件中的动态变化。

title: Fintech Adoption Frameworks: Analyzing Organizational and Leadership Factors that Influence the Successful Implementation of Financial Technologies
affiliations: Hallford University

detail.title: Fintech Adoption Frameworks: Analyzing Organizational and Leadership Factors that Influence the Successful Implementation of Financial Technologies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study paper examines the critical organizational and leadership factors that influence successful fintech adoption within established financial institutions. Through a mixed-methods approach combining quantitative surveys of 187 financial organizations and qualitative interviews with 42 senior executives, this research identifies key determinants of implementation success. The study develops an integrated Fintech Adoption Framework (FAF) that highlights the interplay between organizational readiness, leadership capabilities, and strategic alignment. Findings reveal that transformational leadership, coupled with a clearly articulated digital vision and cross-functional implementation teams, substantially increases adoption success rates. Furthermore, organizations demonstrating high levels of technological absorptive capacity and change management capabilities were 3.7 times more likely to report successful fintech implementations. This research contributes to both academic literature and industry practice by providing a comprehensive framework for financial institutions navigating digital transformation initiatives.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics were considered in creating this research.
declarations.funderStatement: I funded the research for this project.

detail.abstract: This study paper examines the critical organizational and leadership factors that influence successful fintech adoption within established financial institutions. Through a mixedmethods approach combining quantitative surveys of 187 financial organizations and qualitative interviews with 42 senior executives, this research identifies key determinants of implementation success. The study develops an integrated Fintech Adoption Framework (FAF) that highlights the interplay between organizational readiness, leadership capabilities, and strategic alignment. Findings reveal that transformational leadership, coupled with a clearly articulated digital vision and cross-functional implementation teams, substantially increases adoption success rates. Furthermore, organizations demonstrating high levels of technological absorptive capacity and change management capabilities were 3.7 times more likely to report successful fintech implementations. This research contributes to both academic literature and industry practice by providing a comprehensive framework for financial institutions navigating digital transformation initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法（187家金融机构的定量调查和42位高管的定性访谈），识别了影响金融机构成功采用金融科技的关键组织与领导力因素，并开发了一个整合的金融科技采用框架（FAF）。研究发现，变革型领导力、清晰的数字化愿景和跨职能实施团队能显著提高采用成功率，而技术吸收能力和变革管理能力强的组织成功实施金融科技的可能性高出3.7倍。
AI.research_question: 哪些关键的组织和领导力因素会影响金融机构成功采用金融科技？
AI.motivation: 随着金融科技（fintech）的快速发展，传统金融机构面临着数字化转型的压力。然而，许多机构在采用金融科技时遇到挑战，需要理解影响成功实施的关键因素，以指导实践并填补学术研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于组织变革理论、领导力理论（特别是变革型领导力）、技术采纳理论和吸收能力理论，构建了一个整合的金融科技采用框架（FAF），强调组织准备度、领导能力和战略对齐之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：1）对187家金融机构进行定量问卷调查；2）对42位高级管理人员进行定性访谈，结合定性和定量数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）变革型领导力、清晰的数字化愿景和跨职能实施团队能显著提高金融科技采用成功率；2）具有高水平技术吸收能力和变革管理能力的组织成功实施金融科技的可能性是其他组织的3.7倍；3）组织准备度、领导能力和战略对齐的协同作用对成功采用至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）开发了整合的金融科技采用框架（FAF），丰富了数字化转型理论；2）实证验证了组织因素和领导力因素在金融科技采纳中的相互作用；3）扩展了吸收能力理论在金融科技领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融机构提供了实用的金融科技采用框架；2）识别了关键成功因素，帮助机构制定有效的数字化转型策略；3）强调了领导力发展和组织能力建设的重要性，为实践者提供了具体指导。

title: Decomposing the Growth of Part-time Work in South Korea, 2010-2024
affiliations: Korea Development Institute (KDI)

detail.title: Decomposing the Growth of Part-time Work in South Korea, 2010-2024

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI Journal of Economic Policy Vol. 47 No. 4, p. 35-71
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Development Institute (KDI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the factors contributing to the growth of part-time work in South Korea from 2010 to 2024, during which the fraction of part-time workers doubled. A decomposition analysis suggests that changes in the workforce composition account for approximately 30 percent of this growth, primarily driven by workforce aging. However, the explanatory power drops to around 10 percent when excluding workers likely to participate in a government program providing part-time jobs for older workers. This limited explanatory power is attributed to substantial within-group increases and a declining fraction of young workers, partially offsetting the expansion of older workers. These findings suggest that further research is needed to investigate factors beyond compositional changes to explain the recent growth of part-time work in South Korea.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分解分析发现，2010-2024年韩国兼职工作增长中，劳动力构成变化仅解释了约30%，主要受人口老龄化驱动；排除政府老年兼职项目参与者后，解释力降至10%，表明需要研究构成变化之外的因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素导致了2010-2024年韩国兼职工作的增长？劳动力构成变化在其中扮演了多大角色？
AI.motivation: 2010-2024年间韩国兼职工作者比例翻倍，但驱动这一增长的因素尚不明确，需要系统分析以理解韩国劳动力市场的结构性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场分割理论、人口结构变化理论、政府政策干预理论，以及劳动力供给与需求匹配理论。
AI.method: 分解分析方法，将兼职工作增长分解为劳动力构成变化效应和组内变化效应，并特别考虑了政府老年兼职项目的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 劳动力构成变化解释了约30%的兼职增长，主要驱动因素是人口老龄化；2. 排除政府老年兼职项目参与者后，解释力降至10%；3. 年轻工人比例下降部分抵消了老年工人的扩张效应；4. 组内增长显著，表明构成变化之外的因素更为重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了人口结构变化对兼职工作增长的有限解释力；2. 揭示了政府政策在劳动力市场转型中的调节作用；3. 强调了需要超越构成变化视角理解兼职工作扩张。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了劳动力市场干预效果的实证证据；2. 指出需要关注年轻劳动力参与率下降的问题；3. 建议进一步研究其他驱动因素，如企业用工策略、技术进步等。
